name: GOV.UK — domestic abuse: how to get help
description: Official UK government starting information for recognising domestic abuse, immediate danger, silent emergency calling and nation-specific support routes.
intended_use: Use when a query mentions fear, control, violence, sexual pressure or domestic abuse so ordinary relationship communication material is not the only route shown.
audience_or_context: People in the UK seeking domestic-abuse information or help; helplines and legal remedies differ by nation and situation.
limitations: ND Oracle cannot determine from a short query whether abuse has occurred.
Availability and legal remedies differ by nation and can change; use the official page for current routes.
In immediate danger, the official page directs people to emergency services rather than ND Oracle.
cost_or_access_notes: Free public government information; some linked support services have their own opening hours or eligibility.
conflicts_of_interest: Official government guidance; ND Oracle does not infer that a user is a victim or perpetrator merely because this route is shown.
